ui-color-1.$description: Step 1 of the palette, at 98% lightness.

ui-color-2.$description: Step 2 of the palette, at 97% lightness.

ui-color-3.$description: Step 3 of the palette, at 93% lightness.

ui-color-4.$description: Step 4 of the palette, at 84% lightness.

ui-color-5.$description: Step 5 of the palette, at 80% lightness.

ui-color-6.$description: Step 6 of the palette, at 71% lightness.

ui-color-7.$description: Step 7 of the palette, at 66% lightness.

ui-color-8.$description: Step 8 of the palette, at 58% lightness.

ui-color-9.$description: Step 9 of the palette, at 53% lightness.

ui-color-10.$description: Step 10 of the palette, at 49% lightness.

ui-color-11.$description: Step 11 of the palette, at 42% lightness.

ui-color-12.$description: Step 12 of the palette, at 35% lightness.

ui-color-13.$description: Step 13 of the palette, at 27% lightness.

ui-color-14.$description: Step 14 of the palette, at 20% lightness.

ui-color-15.$description: Step 15 of the palette, at 16% lightness.

ui-color-16.$description: Step 16 of the palette, at 10% lightness.

ui-gray-1.$description: Step 1 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-1` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-2.$description: Step 2 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-2` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-3.$description: Step 3 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-3` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-4.$description: Step 4 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-4` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-5.$description: Step 5 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-5` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-6.$description: Step 6 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-6` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-7.$description: Step 7 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-7` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-8.$description: Step 8 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-8` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-9.$description: Step 9 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-9` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-10.$description: Step 10 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-10` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-11.$description: Step 11 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-11` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-12.$description: Step 12 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-12` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-13.$description: Step 13 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-13` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-14.$description: Step 14 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-14` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-15.$description: Step 15 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-15` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-gray-16.$description: Step 16 of the gray palette: the lightness of `--ui-color-16` at `--ui-gray-chroma` and `--ui-gray-hue`.

ui-palette-accent.$description: The accent shade of the current palette: `Callout` icons and outlined borders. Stronger with more contrast. The severity `Chip` dot reads it. Re-derived inside every severity scope, so `.ui-success` gets a green one.

ui-palette-border.$description: The border shade of the current palette: tonal `Callout` borders. Stronger with more contrast. Severity `Chip` borders read it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-palette-strong.$description: The strongest shade of the current palette, the darkest in light mode and the lightest in dark mode, with the most contrast against the page: `Callout` text, the default `Button` fill when `--ui-button-accent` is unset. Severity `Chip` text reads it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-palette-text.$description: A readable text shade of the current palette, at least `--ui-palette-text-min-lightness` in dark mode. Darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-palette-tint.$description: The tonal fill of the current palette: primary and critical tonal buttons when `--ui-primary-tonal` is unset. Stronger with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-palette-tint-subtle.$description: A faint fill of the current palette: tonal severity `Callout`s. Tonal severity `Chip`s read it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.

ui-blue.$description: A literal blue, hue 240 at `0.53`, the lightness of palette step 9 in every palette. No severity meaning.

ui-green.$description: A literal green, hue 145 at `0.53`, the lightness of palette step 9 in every palette. No severity meaning.

ui-orange.$description: A literal orange, hue 75 at `0.66`, the lightness of palette step 7 in every palette. No severity meaning.

ui-red.$description: A literal red, hue 25 at `0.53`, the lightness of palette step 9 in every palette. No severity meaning.

ui-critical.$description: Severity color for errors and destructive actions.

ui-critical-text.$description: Critical as a text color: the `.ui-critical` items of a `Menu`, a `.ui-critical` `Button` with no variant or `.ui-outlined`, and `del` and `.ui-del` text. `--ui-critical` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.

ui-info.$description: Severity color for informational messages, and the dotted underline of `abbr`, `dfn`, `.ui-abbr` and `.ui-dfn`.

ui-info-text.$description: Info as a text color, for informational text outside an `.ui-info` scope. `--ui-info` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.

ui-invalid.$description: Color for invalid field borders, fills and outlines. Lifted to `--ui-invalid-min-lightness` in dark mode, so invalid borders stand out from the page with more contrast.

ui-invalid-text.$description: Color for validation messages and invalid labels. `--ui-invalid` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`, so it stays readable where `--ui-invalid` is lighter for borders.

ui-neutral.$description: Severity color for neutral messages. `--ui-gray-hue` and `--ui-gray-chroma` at `0.53`, the lightness of `--ui-gray-9`, capped at `--ui-accent-max-lightness` in light mode. The `.ui-neutral` scope derives its palette from its hue and chroma.

ui-neutral-text.$description: Neutral as a text color, for neutral text outside an `.ui-neutral` scope. `--ui-neutral` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.

ui-success-text.$description: Success as a text color, for success text outside an `.ui-success` scope, and `ins` and `.ui-ins` text. `--ui-success` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.

ui-warning.$description: Severity color for warnings. Unlike the other severities it keeps its lightness with more contrast: the fill is light and takes dark `--ui-on-warning` text, and `--ui-warning-text` gets the stricter lightness limits instead.

ui-on-warning.$description: Text color on a `--ui-warning` fill: the warning `Badge`. White on a warning below 0.182 relative luminance and near-black above it, like `--ui-on-primary`.

ui-warning-text.$description: Warning as a text color, for warning text outside a `.ui-warning` scope. `--ui-warning` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.

ui-primary.$description: Brand color for primary actions and accents. Derived from `--ui-primary-source` within `--ui-primary-max-lightness` and `--ui-primary-min-lightness`. Set `--ui-primary-source` to keep more contrast working, or this token to pin the color.

ui-on-primary.$description: Text color on `--ui-primary`. Derived with relative color from the primary's relative luminance (the `y` of `xyz-d65`): white on a primary below 0.182, near-black above it, so either side keeps 4.5:1 and a custom `--ui-primary` gets readable text.

ui-primary-text.$description: Primary as a text color: links, rich text links, `Callout` link hover, `Button` and `ButtonGroup` with `.ui-primary` and no variant or `.ui-outlined`. Defaults to `--ui-primary` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`, and is derived again from the more-contrast primary. Set it when the primary needs another shade for text.

ui-selected-strong.$description: Mark of a selected item that has to stand out from the page on its own: the current `Carousel` marker, the bar on the start edge of a selected `List` row, the selected tab of filled `Tabs`, the current `Stepper` and `Timeline` markers, and the done part of a `Progress` bar, a `Stepper` and a tracked `Timeline`. Defaults to `--ui-primary`. `--ui-selected` is the fill behind a selected item and may be faint.

ui-on-selected-strong.$description: Text color on `--ui-selected-strong`: the selected tab of filled `Tabs` and the number or icon of the current `Stepper` and `Timeline` markers. Defaults to `--ui-on-primary`.

ui-text-strong.$description: Strongest text color, for headings, labels and values. Body text is `--ui-text`.

ui-text.$description: Body text color. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-text-strength-light` or `--ui-text-strength-dark`.

ui-text-subtle.$description: Secondary text: placeholders, field helper text, overlines, descriptions in `List` and `Menu` items, unselected `Tabs` labels and `Table` captions. `--ui-text` unless a theme sets it.

ui-text-disabled.$description: Text color of disabled buttons and chips. `--ui-text` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-text-disabled-strength`. Also the label and border of an unchecked disabled `ToggleButton`.

ui-on-fill.$description: Text on an intent fill: an intent color with its lightness capped so light text reads on it, within `--ui-accent-fill-max-lightness` for critical `Button`s and the critical, info, neutral and success `Badge`, and within `--ui-choice-fill-max-lightness` for the invalid choice mark and the checked one in dark mode. Near-white in both modes. The fill has no token of its own, since each intent is one. Not `--ui-palette-on-strong`, which turns dark in dark mode for the light `--ui-palette-strong`.

ui-surface-elevated.$description: Background of elevated cards and accordions, dialogs, drawers, menus and native `Select` options.

ui-surface-filled.$description: Background of filled areas: lists, `.ui-filled` progress and range tracks, table headers and footers, and hovered table rows.

ui-surface-inverse.$description: Background of `Tooltip`, the `Carousel` buttons and `kbd`, `var`, `.ui-kbd` and `.ui-var`, inverted against the page.

ui-surface-tonal-hover.$description: Hover fill of a `--ui-surface-tonal` surface: clickable `Chip`s, filled `TextField`, `Select` and `Textarea` fields, and tonal `Button`s with `--ui-button-hover: shade-all`. Derived from `--ui-surface-tonal`, darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode.

ui-border-width.$description: Default border width for components that draw a border.

ui-border-width-thick.$description: Width of emphasized rules: the head and foot rules of rich text tables, the `AvatarGroup` ring, the `Badge` border, the neutral `Chip` dot, the dotted `DescriptionList` rule, the `Tabs` indicator, the bar on a selected `List` row, the `Spinner` ring, and at one and a half times, the blockquote bar.

ui-radius.$description: Corner radius for every component: cards, callouts, menus, buttons and fields follow it, and small parts like `kbd`, tooltips and checkboxes never get rounder than it. Set it to `0` for square corners. Takes a single length.

ui-radius-round.$description: The pill radius for round buttons, avatars, badges, the chip dot, radios, switches, the range track and the carousel buttons and markers.

ui-radius-large.$description: Corner radius for large surfaces, such as cards and dialogs that want more rounding than controls. `--ui-radius` times 1.5, so `0` still squares it. Not read by a component yet.

ui-radius-small.$description: Corner radius of small parts: `kbd`, inline `code`, `mark`, `var`, `Tooltip`, the file input and a `rounded` `Avatar`. `--ui-radius`, capped at 5px.

ui-radius-x-small.$description: Corner radius of the `Checkbox` box. `--ui-radius`, capped at 2px.

ui-border-color.$description: Default border color for cards, lists, tables and dividers. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-border-strength-light` or `--ui-border-strength-dark`.

ui-border-color-on-filled.$description: Border color inside filled surfaces: lists without a variant and table headers. `List` and `Table` set `--ui-border-color` to it on those parts.

ui-border-color-on-raised.$description: Borders drawn inside a raised surface (tonal and elevated `Card` and `Accordion`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Menu`, the `Select` picker and tonal `Callout` without a severity): dividers, separators, outlined controls. The same mix as `--ui-border-color` by default. Each raised component sets `--ui-border-color` to it on its root, so a theme that wants another border inside raised surfaces sets this one. The edge of the surface itself is `--ui-border-color-raised`.

ui-border-color-raised.$description: The edge of every raised surface: tonal and elevated `Card`, `Accordion` and `Dialog`, tonal `Callout` without a severity, `Drawer`, `Menu` and the `Select` picker. Set it to outline them all at once, or to `transparent` to drop their edges. When unset, each keeps its own edge: cards, accordions and dialogs the page background, so they stay visible on tonal surfaces, callouts their tonal background, and drawers, menus and the picker `--ui-border-color-on-raised`. The borders inside a raised surface are `--ui-border-color-on-raised`.

ui-field-bg-color.$description: Background of `TextField`, `Textarea` and `Select` fields. When unset, `--ui-surface`, the page color.

ui-field-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding inside `TextField`, `Textarea` and `Select` fields. When unset, `--ui-space-2`. `.ui-large` reads `--ui-field-padding-inline-large`.

ui-field-placeholder-text-color.$description: Color of placeholder text in fields. When unset, `--ui-text-subtle`.

ui-field-helper-text-color.$description: Text color for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-helper-font-size.$description: Font size for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-helper-line-height.$description: Line height for helper and end text under a field.

ui-field-label-font-weight.$description: Font weight for emphasized field labels and legends.

ui-field-border-color.$description: Border color of every empty control: `TextField`, `Select`, `Textarea`, the unchecked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` unless `--ui-choice-border-color` is set, the `Range` track and the `Progress` outline. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-field-border-strength`, so it reaches 3:1. Lighter than `--ui-border-color`, which is decorative, is a choice a theme can make.

ui-field-border-color-on-filled.$description: Field border color inside filled surfaces: lists without a variant and table headers. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface-filled` at `--ui-field-border-strength`.

ui-field-border-color-on-raised.$description: Field border color inside raised surfaces. The same mix as `--ui-field-border-color` by default. Each raised component sets `--ui-field-border-color` to it on its root.

ui-focus-ring-offset.$description: Distance between a control and its focus ring.

ui-focus-ring-width.$description: Width of the focus ring. `3px` with more contrast.

ui-focus-ring-color.$description: Color of the keyboard focus ring. Black on surfaces lighter than OKLCH 0.6 and white on darker ones, so it reaches 3:1 on any `--ui-surface`.

ui-focus-ring-inset.$description: Negative offset for focus rings drawn inside a control, such as `ButtonGroup`, `List` items and `Select` options.

ui-focus-highlight.$description: Fill of a focused link or button that highlights instead of showing the ring, when `--ui-link-focus` or `--ui-button-focus` is `highlight`: `--ui-focus-ring-color` made opaque. A translucent ring, like Bootstrap's, fills at full strength, since text contrast on a see-through fill depends on what is behind it.

ui-on-focus-highlight.$description: Text color on `--ui-focus-highlight`, and the bar under a highlighted link: black or white, whichever reads on it. It switches at OKLCH lightness 0.57, where black and white both reach 4.5:1 on a gray, since it colors text; the focus ring switches at 0.6, which only needs 3:1. Set it to match a brand's focus text, and hand it back under more contrast with the ring color.

ui-font-body.$description: Font family for body text, fields and buttons. `system-ui, sans-serif` by default.

ui-font-code.$description: Font family for `code`, `kbd`, `samp` and `pre` in rich text, `.ui-kbd`, `.ui-samp`, `.ui-var`, code blocks and `kbd` in buttons and lists. A monospace stack by default.

ui-font-size-100.$description: The smallest step of the type scale, 12px. `--ui-font-size-caption` reads it. Set the steps to reshape every size at once, or a role to move one.

ui-font-size-300.$description: Type scale step, 16px. `--ui-font-size-body`, `--ui-font-size-control` and `--ui-font-size-h6` read it.

ui-font-size-400.$description: Type scale step, 18px. `--ui-font-size-h5` reads it, and `--ui-font-size-h4` grows from it.

ui-font-size-500.$description: Type scale step, 20px. `--ui-font-size-large` reads it, `--ui-font-size-h3` grows from it and `--ui-font-size-h4` grows to it.

ui-font-size-600.$description: Type scale step, 24px. `--ui-font-size-h2` grows from it and `--ui-font-size-h3` grows to it.

ui-font-size-700.$description: Type scale step, 32px. `--ui-font-size-h1` grows from it.

ui-font-size-800.$description: Type scale step, 40px. `--ui-font-size-h2` grows to it.

ui-font-size-900.$description: The largest step of the type scale, 56px. `--ui-font-size-h1` grows to it.

ui-font-weight-normal.$description: Font weight for body text, `List` text and `Button` keyboard shortcuts.

ui-font-weight-medium.$description: Font weight for badges, overlines and group labels.

ui-font-weight-semibold.$description: Font weight for labels, table headers and titles.

ui-font-weight-bold.$description: Font weight for headings, buttons and terms.

ui-letter-spacing-caps.$description: Letter spacing of uppercase text: overlines and the first paragraph of an `hgroup`. Scales with the font size: the value is at 16px.

ui-letter-spacing-display.$description: Letter spacing of `h1` and `h2`, tighter than the body.

ui-letter-spacing-heading.$description: Letter spacing of `h3` and `h4`, slightly tighter than the body.

ui-line-height-tight.$description: Line height of single-line controls and compact text: field inputs, dense `Table` cells, the `Stat` value, `Tooltip`, `Card` captions and keyboard hints in buttons.

ui-line-height-control.$description: Line height of interface text: labels, helpers, choice labels and field hints.

ui-line-height.$description: Line height of captions, `List` text, the `Stat` label and description and the `Stepper` description. Body text and prose use `--ui-line-height-relaxed`.

ui-line-height-relaxed.$description: Line height of the page text set on `html`, and of `Tabs` labels.

ui-line-height-prose.$description: Line height of `.ui-rich-text`, for themes whose prose is looser than their interface text. When unset, rich text keeps the line height around it, `--ui-line-height-relaxed` on the page.

ui-rhythm-step.$description: Vertical rhythm unit. Rich text margins and heading line heights round to it.

ui-underline-offset.$description: Gap between text and its underline for `Link`, rich text links and `Stepper` links.

ui-underline-offset-small.$description: Gap between text and the underline of `abbr`, `dfn`, `ins` and `u` and their classes.

ui-underline-thickness-hover.$description: Underline thickness of `Link` and rich text links on hover and keyboard focus. At rest they keep the font's own thickness.

ui-font-size-caption.$description: Font size of captions, `Badge`, `Chip`, `Divider` labels, `List` secondary text, `Menu` shortcuts, overlines, `small`, `figcaption` and x-small buttons, toggles and fields. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-100`.

ui-font-size-small.$description: Font size of helper text, `Callout`, `Table`, `Tooltip`, code blocks, `List` text, small buttons, toggles and fields, and large chips. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-200`.

ui-font-size-body.$description: Font size of body copy, `Card` text and the `Callout` title. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-font-size-control.$description: Font size of the default `Button`, `Select`, `Tabs`, `TextField`, `Textarea` and `ToggleButton`. Small and x-small sizes read `--ui-font-size-small` and `--ui-font-size-caption`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-font-size-large.$description: Font size of lead paragraphs, `.ui-p.ui-large`, large `Avatar` initials, the `DescriptionList` total row, the value of a small `Stat` and the `OneTimeCode` digits. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-500`.

ui-fluid-progress.$description: Position of the viewport inline size in the `--ui-fluid-min-inline-size` to `--ui-fluid-max-inline-size` window, 0 to 1, from `progress()`. `--ui-font-size-h1` to `--ui-font-size-h4` grow with it, and a theme can ramp other values on the same window.

ui-font-size-h1.$description: Font size for `h1` and `.ui-h1`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-700` to `--ui-font-size-900` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h2.$description: Font size for `h2` and `.ui-h2`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-600` to `--ui-font-size-800` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h3.$description: Font size for `h3` and `.ui-h3`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-500` to `--ui-font-size-600` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h4.$description: Font size for `h4` and `.ui-h4`. Grows from `--ui-font-size-400` to `--ui-font-size-500` with `--ui-fluid-progress`.

ui-font-size-h5.$description: Font size for `h5` and `.ui-h5`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-400`.

ui-font-size-h6.$description: Font size for `h6` and `.ui-h6`. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-300`.

ui-code-bg-color.$description: Background of inline `code` in rich text and `Typography`. `--ui-text` at `--ui-code-bg-alpha-light` in light mode and `--ui-code-bg-alpha-dark` in dark mode, fainter with more contrast so the text stands out.

ui-code-block-bg-color.$description: Background of `pre.ui-code-block` and `pre` in rich text. `--ui-surface-inverse` in light mode and `--ui-surface-filled` in dark mode, so the block is dark in both.

ui-code-block-text-color.$description: Text color of `pre.ui-code-block` and `pre` in rich text. `--ui-on-inverse` in light mode and `--ui-text-strong` in dark mode, on `--ui-code-block-bg-color`.

ui-card-padding.$description: Padding of `Card`, `Dialog`, `Drawer` and `Accordion` content, headers, footers and actions, and of `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` cards. When unset, `--ui-space-3`.

ui-list-item-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding of `List` and `Menu` items, headings and `Select` options. When unset, `--ui-space-3`.

ui-control-border-color.$description: Border color of controls without a fill: `Button` with `.ui-outlined`, the edge and dividers of an outlined `ButtonGroup`, `ToggleButton`, `ToggleGroup`, `Chip` with `.ui-outlined`, the track of `Tabs` with `.ui-outlined`, and the selected `Tabs` pill. When unset, outlined buttons use their color, the selected `Tabs` pill `--ui-field-border-color` and the rest `--ui-border-color`. Themes that outline controls like fields set it to `--ui-field-border-color`.

ui-control-border-color-filled.$description: Border color of controls with a fill: `Button` with `.ui-filled` or `.ui-tonal`, the edge of a filled or tonal `ButtonGroup` and the dividers of a tonal or default one (filled groups keep `currentColor` dividers, or a shade of the accent in primary and critical ones), a checked `ToggleButton`, `Chip` without `.ui-outlined` and the `Carousel` buttons. When unset, buttons have no visible border, the carousel buttons use a shade of their fill and the rest use `--ui-border-color`. Set it with `--ui-control-border-color` to outline every control.

ui-track-bg-color.$description: The empty part of a track: the unchecked `Switch`, `Progress` and the `Range` track. When unset, `Progress` and tonal ranges use `--ui-surface-tonal`, the default range its field border and the switch `--ui-switch-track-bg-color`.

ui-control-size-x-small.$description: Shared x-small height for fields and buttons.

ui-control-size-small.$description: Shared small height for fields and buttons.

ui-control-size.$description: Shared default height for fields and buttons so they line up.

ui-control-size-large.$description: Shared large height for fields and buttons.

ui-button-accent-filled.$description: Fill of `Button` and `ButtonGroup` with `.ui-filled` and no `.ui-primary` or `.ui-critical`, of hovered outlined ones unless `--ui-button-hover` is `layer`, and of hovered tonal ones when it is unset. When unset, `--ui-button-accent`, so text, outlined and filled buttons share one color.

ui-button-on-accent-filled.$description: Text color on a `--ui-button-accent-filled` fill. Set it with `--ui-button-accent-filled`. When unset, `--ui-button-on-accent`.

ui-button-font-weight.$description: Font weight of `Button`. When unset, buttons follow `--ui-font-weight-bold`.

ui-button-padding-inline-x-small.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button` with `.ui-x-small`. When unset, `1ex`.

ui-button-padding-inline-small.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button` with `.ui-small`. When unset, `1.25ex`.

ui-button-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button`. When unset, `1.5ex`, which scales with the font.

ui-button-padding-inline-large.$description: Horizontal padding of `Button` with `.ui-large`. When unset, `2.5ex`.

ui-divider-gap.$description: Block margin around a `Divider`, times `--ui-space-scale`. Cards, callouts, dialogs and drawers set it to `--ui-space-3`. A divider that is a direct child of a card has no margin, since the card's gap already spaces it.

ui-selected.$description: Background of a selected control: a checked `ToggleButton`, the selected `ToggleGroup` item, a pressed `Chip`, and a selected or current `List` item and `Select` option. When unset, `--ui-primary` on toggles and `--ui-primary` at `--ui-state-selected-alpha-accent` on list items and options. Pair it with `--ui-on-selected`.

ui-on-selected.$description: Text color on `--ui-selected`. When unset, `--ui-on-primary` on toggles, the item's own text color on list items and selected `Select` options.

ui-icon-size-x-small.$description: Smallest icon size, for icons in x-small controls. Not read by a component yet.

ui-icon-size-small.$description: Icon size inside `Chip`, x-small `Avatar` and dense `List` rows, and the `Select` and autosuggest chevron.

ui-icon-size-large.$description: Icon size inside `Avatar`, and of an `svg` without a `width` in `normalize.css`.

ui-choice-accent.$description: Fill of a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`, and the thumb and fill of `Range`. When unset, `--ui-control-accent`, else `--ui-primary`, with its lightness capped in dark mode for the choice controls. Set it, or `--ui-control-accent`, to `--ui-primary` for the plain primary, like Material and shadcn.

ui-choice-on-accent.$description: Color of the mark on a checked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`. Set it with `--ui-choice-accent`. When unset, `--ui-on-control-accent`, else `--ui-on-primary` in light mode and near-white in dark mode.

ui-choice-label-offset.$description: Moves `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` labels down (positive) or up (negative) against their control. Use `em` or `cap` to scale with the label font.

ui-choice-ripple-bg-color.$description: Halo color for the `Checkbox` and `Radio` hover effect. `--ui-text` at 20%.

ui-choice-size-small.$description: `Checkbox` and `Radio` input size with `.ui-small`, and in dense `List` rows unless the control has a size class.

ui-switch-thumb-size-small.$description: Diameter of the `Switch` thumb with `.ui-small`, and in `List` rows unless the switch has a size class.

ui-switch-track-block-size-small.$description: Height of the `Switch` track with `.ui-small`, and in `List` rows unless the switch has a size class.

ui-switch-track-inline-size-x-small.$description: Width of the `Switch` track with `.ui-x-small`. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size-x-small` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-track-inline-size-small.$description: Width of the `Switch` track with `.ui-small`, and in `List` rows unless the switch has a size class. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size-small` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-track-inline-size.$description: Width of the `Switch` track. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-track-inline-size-large.$description: Width of the `Switch` track with `.ui-large`. Twice `--ui-switch-track-block-size-large` until a theme sets it.

ui-switch-thumb-bg-color.$description: Color of the unchecked `Switch` thumb. The checked thumb uses `--ui-choice-on-accent`.

ui-switch-track-bg-color.$description: Background of the unchecked `Switch` track when `--ui-track-bg-color` is unset.

ui-backdrop-blur.$description: Blur radius behind an open `Dialog` or `Drawer`.

ui-backdrop-bg-color.$description: Overlay color behind an open `Dialog` or `Drawer`. `--ui-text` at 50% in light mode, and half the lightness of `--ui-surface` at 50% in dark mode.
